name: Breadcrumb
summary: Named navigation trail with an ordered hierarchy, repeatable linked items, hidden visual separators, current-page state, visible focus, and wrap-safe long content.

anatomy.name: list
anatomy.description: Ordered list that preserves the hierarchical sequence and item count.

anatomy.name: item
anatomy.description: Repeatable ordered-list item containing one destination or the current page and an optional hidden separator.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Default breadcrumb spacing and text size.

states.name: linkHover
states.description: Pointer hover keeps primary text contrast and adds the accent underline to a breadcrumb link.

states.name: linkFocusVisible
states.description: Keyboard focus remains visually distinct on each linked ancestor.

behavior.name: navigationLandmark
behavior.description: Breadcrumbs should render as a named navigation landmark.

behavior.name: orderedHierarchy
behavior.description: The path is an ordered hierarchy of one or more list items from broadest ancestor to current page.

behavior.name: currentPage
behavior.description: The current page segment should be marked with aria-current="page".

behavior.name: separatorSemantics
behavior.description: Visual separators should not be announced as extra breadcrumb items.

behavior.name: contentResilience
behavior.description: Long and localized labels wrap without hiding hierarchy; collapse, ellipsis, and overflow menus are unsupported v1 target extensions.

properties.name: label
properties.description: Accessible name for the breadcrumb navigation landmark.

properties.name: currentLabel
properties.description: Visible label for the current page segment marked with aria-current.

accessibility: Use a named nav landmark with an ordered list and list items for the complete hierarchy.
Mark the current page with aria-current="page".
Hide purely visual separators from assistive technology.
Keep breadcrumb labels concise and ordered from broadest to current page.
Preserve a visible focus indicator and the complete path when content wraps.

web.notes: Implemented by class composition in components/css/layout.css.

shopify.notes: The Shopify snippet renders the same nav, ordered-list, item, link, separator, and current-page class contract.
